stance_rationale: RF-O9 single-snapshot failure is avoided, but the emitted optimizer package violates hard turnover and MDD gates, relies on a risk input with cond=153.92 > 100, and does not issue infeasibility handling for CVaR/heavy-tail breaches. This is not approval-ready portfolio construction.

critical_concerns.description: Turnover hard gate is breached: computed weights.csv annual one-way turnover is 15.1901, far above the 600% cap (=6.0). The package still states infeasibility_report=null and claims all hard constraints are satisfied.

Optimizer-selected AlphaSoftmax_T05 has expected_mdd=-48.57%, breaching the base MDD <45% hard fail gate; all reported 267m methods have MDD worse than -45%, so this required infeasibility or redesign rather than Forge deferral.

Risk-side tail breach is not handled: CVaR95 loss 11.83%, CDaR95 31.15%, and EVT xi99=2.3335 imply heavy-tail conditions, yet the optimizer selected an alpha-rank softmax method instead of HRP/CVaR/Kelly fallback and issued no infeasibility report.

covariance.parquet is symmetric and PSD, but post-shrink condition number is 153.91935, exceeding the required cond <=100 threshold. The optimizer uses this Sigma basis while treating the risk breach as inherited rather than blocking.

The selection objective is under-penalized for hard failures: AlphaSoftmax_T05 wins by crowding_adj_ret even though TO=15.18 and MDD=-48.57. A soft lambda_TO cannot override RF-O13 or the base MDD hard gate.

AX-001 v2 stress evidence collapses at optimizer-forward-return level: selected method has CAUTION SR=-2.2857 and CRISIS SR=-1.9737, contradicting inherited risk-package stress PASS based on a different return convention.
Sequential Admission is missing: no TDC vs PG2/MEGA_05, no replacement scenario, no integration scenario, and no beta_port versus benchmark target [1.00,1.05] are reported.

Canonical alpha_scores.parquet requested for Iter-4 RF-A7 verification is absent; only alpha_scores_new.parquet exists and it includes Ret_1m beside scores, preserving a downstream circular-use risk even though weights.csv itself is time-series.
Liquidity enforcement uses 5e7 KRW from request.json instead of the base-context 2e8 KRW mandate; direct 20d trading-amount audit found four selected holding rows below 2e8 KRW.

supporting_arguments: weights.csv is a real schedule: 268 sig_dates from 2004-01-01 to 2026-04-01, 5360 rows, exactly 20 names per date.
Per-date weight sums pass: max absolute sum error about 1.55e-15; long-only and max_w <=0.20 pass.
2026-04-01 top 20 alpha-ranked names are all weighted, so RF-O1 is not triggered for the live snapshot.
CRISIS rows use max_w <=0.10, showing boundary shrink was implemented, but no cash sleeve is documented.
optimizer_challenge_note.md exists and explicitly describes the walk-forward handoff, so Charter Section 8 documentation exists at optimizer stage.
